rules.range: 08:00-09:00 Europe/London, all60M1 required; midpoint extrema define sweep levels
rules.signal_window: ClosedM5 from09:05 until14:30 exclusive; hard exit16:00 Europe/London
rules.sweep: M5 high>=rangehigh+tick with close strictly inside range =>SELL; low<=rangelow-tick with inside close =>BUY; both sides in sameM5 rejected as ambiguous
rules.MSS_reference: At sweep close freeze latest confirmed opposite M5 pivot among preceding12 centre slots, price beyond sweepclose in intended direction; strict2left2right, all5complete, known_at<=sweepclose
rules.no_reference: Reject sweep rather than invent a swing
rules.MSS: First later M5 close strictly beyond frozen pivot within6bars; require directional body>=ATR14 of precedingM5 and directional three-barFVG of at least1tick at that first break; otherwise cancel setup
rules.ATR: TA-Lib Wilder14, complete consecutiveM5 segments, reset after gap; previous-bar value only
rules.FVG: BUY low[s]-high[s-2]>=tick; SELL low[s-2]-high[s]>=tick; all3bars complete, known at close[s]
rules.return: First subsequent completeM5 close inside FVG including boundaries within6bars afterMSS; one attempt even if rejected by account or quote
rules.FVG_invalidation: BUY close<gaplow or SELL close>gaphigh cancels before return
rules.stop: Sweep M5 executable bid_low minus tick forBUY, ask_high plus tick forSELL; never widened
rules.setup_invalidation: Any observed executable touch of stop on closed bars after sweep cancels before MSS/return; no intrabar favorable ordering assumed
rules.setup_state: One pending setup; new sweeps ignored while active. Expiry or invalidation bar is not reused to start a new setup
rules.order_block: Annotation only: last strictly opposite candle among5completeM5 beforeMSS; whole mid high-low, known_at=MSSclose; absence does not reject entry
rules.entry: Market quote at M1 open after return M5 close, firstquote<=5sec, midpoint must still be inside FVG; no midpoint limit fill invented
rules.target: Opposite executable-side frozen range extreme: bid_high forBUY, ask_low forSELL; known09:00; minimum planned net quote reward/risk2 after modeled fees/slip
rules.liquidity_caveat: Range/pivots/FVG/OB are formal price patterns, not proof of institutional orders or untouched liquidity
rules.costs: Same bid/ask cache, fee/slip base and higher_costs as frozen V03; stop first if stop/TP both reachableM1; target penetration1tick
rules.signal_gap: Cancel pending setup and stop forming session signals; no interpolation
rules.exposure_gap: Halt continuous portfolio; total net unknown; retain known costs
